title: MMDA halts road excavation ahead of Asean summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) will impose a moratorium on road excavations from Nov. 1 until midnight on Dec. 23. The moratorium aims to limit road disruptions during preparations for the upcoming 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit scheduled for Nov. 16-18 and the Christmas season.
